title: Payoff Amount and Per Diem on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Customer Quote
content:
**Calculation standard.** On a customer payoff quote for a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract:

- The **per diem** is the principal balance times the contract APR divided by 100 divided by the day basis (365 days, from the payment schedule of the tier), rounded to the cent.
- The **good-through date** is the tier's quote validity days (10 calendar days) after the quote date.
- The **quote interest days** run from the day after the interest-paid-to date through the good-through date, both inclusive.
- The **payoff amount** is the principal balance plus the fees due balance plus the per diem times the quote interest days, rounded to the cent.

**Days on either side of maturity.** The quote interest days after the maturity date are those that fall after the maturity date; the other quote interest days fall on or before it. Every courtesy day that applies is taken off the quote interest days after the maturity date, which never fall below zero; each quote interest day that remains is charged at the daily rate that applies to it, and the payoff amount is rounded to the cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical contract)

Principal balance USD 18,250.00, APR 7.30%, fees due USD 35.00, interest paid to the 4th of a month, quote dated the 10th, maturity well after the good-through date.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Per diem: 18,250.00 times 7.30 divided by 100 divided by 365 | USD 3.65 |
| Good-through date: 10 days after the 10th | The 20th |
| Quote interest days: the 5th through the 20th | 16 |
| Payoff amount: 18,250.00 plus 35.00 plus 3.65 times 16 | USD 18,343.40 |
